basic_details.short_information: 338 vacancies are open at the Andhra Pradesh State Cooperative Bank (APCOB) under the APCOB Recruitment 2026 notification for the posts of Assistant Manager (Scale-I) and Staff Assistant. APCOB and the Andhra Pradesh District Cooperative Central Banks (DCCBs) invite online applications from 24 July 2026, with 7 August 2026 as the last date to apply.

application_fee.details: The application fee/intimation charges (non-refundable) are the same across all six DCCBs and both posts, and must be paid online only. | Bank transaction charges for online payment are additional and must be borne by the candidate, including those applying under reserved categories. Payment can be made using Debit Card, Credit Card, Internet Banking, IMPS, UPI, or mobile wallets.

age_limit.details: The age of the candidate is reckoned as on 01.06.2026. | Minimum age: 20 years Maximum age: 30 years (for open market candidates, both Staff Assistant and Assistant Manager) Maximum age for PACS in-service candidates: Relaxation up to 45 years for OC, with further category-wise relaxation subject to an overall ceiling of 50 years

qualification.details: Each DCCB recruits only for its own district's requirements, so candidates must be local to the erstwhile district of the post they are applying for. For example, only candidates local to erstwhile Chittoor district can apply for Chittoor DCCB posts, and only candidates local to erstwhile Kadapa district can apply for Kadapa DCCB posts, and so on for Nellore, Prakasam, Visakhapatnam, and Vizianagaram. Local status is generally determined based on either of the following: | Having studied in an educational institution in the local area for at least 4 consecutive academic years up to the SSC (or equivalent) examination; or Having resided in the local area for at least 4 years immediately preceding the SSC (or equivalent) examination, if not covered under the study criterion above. | Candidates who do not meet the 4-year local criterion may still be considered local under a 7-year study/residence criterion within the state, as detailed in the respective official notification. | Candidates holding a graduation degree in any discipline can also explore more Graduate Government Jobs and Bank Jobs 2026 available across India. | The age of the candidate is reckoned as on 01.06.2026. | Minimum age: 20 years Maximum age: 30 years (for open market candidates, both Staff Assistant and Assistant Manager) Maximum age for PACS in-service candidates: Relaxation up to 45 years for OC, with further category-wise relaxation subject to an overall ceiling of 50 years | The relaxation in upper age limit is cumulative as per government guidelines, and reserved-category candidates must submit the relevant community certificate at the time of document verification to claim age relaxation.

Selection to both Staff Assistant and Assistant Manager posts (open market category) is based purely on performance in the Online Written Test
followed by document verification and a medical fitness check. There is no interview for either post. The broad stages are:
Stage 1: Online Written Examination Stage 2: Document Verification Stage 3: Medical Fitness Examination Stage 4: Final Appointment (subject to executing the service bond)
The online test for Staff Assistant and Assistant Manager (open market candidates) will be conducted in English
and has a composite duration of 2 hours (120 minutes). There is a negative marking of 0.25 marks for every wrong answer; unattempted questions carry no penalty.
Candidates applying under the PACS quota for Staff Assistant posts will be tested separately
on the working and functions of PACS.

The same negative marking rule of 0.25 marks per wrong answer applies to this test as well. The Certified PACS Secretary (CPS) study material (4 modules) has been indicated as the reference material for this test.
how_to_apply: Candidates can apply only through the official website of the DCCB corresponding to the post/district they wish to apply for, and only during the online registration window. Follow the steps below:
Visit the official website of the concerned DCCB (Chittoor, Kadapa, Nellore, Prakasam, Visakhapatnam, or Vizianagaram DCCB, as applicable).
Click on the "Apply Online" link on the homepage.
Select "Click here for New Registration" and enter your name, contact details, and email ID to generate a Provisional Registration Number and Password.
Log in using the generated credentials and fill in the online application form with personal, educational, and other required details.
Upload the scanned photograph, signature, left thumb impression, and a handwritten declaration as per the specified format and size.
Preview the application form carefully before final submission, since no correction is allowed after clicking "Completed Registration."
Pay the requisite application fee/intimation charges through the online payment gateway.
Submit the application and save/print the system-generated e-receipt and application form for your own records.

Before starting the online registration, keep ready a scanned photograph (4.5cm × 3.5cm), signature in black ink, left thumb impression, and a handwritten declaration in English, since these need to be uploaded during the application process.
important_instructions: Only one online application should be submitted per post; details cannot be modified after final submission. Signature must not be in capital letters and must be in black ink; the handwritten declaration must be in the candidate's own handwriting and in English only. Candidates already employed must produce a "No Objection Certificate" from their current employer at the time of document verification. Bank transaction charges for the online fee payment are to be borne by the candidate and are not included in the fee amount shown above. Candidates using a scribe (visually impaired or those with a permanently affected writing speed) are eligible for compensatory time of 20 minutes per hour of examination, subject to prior registration for the same in the application form. Canvassing in any form, or furnishing incorrect information at any stage, will lead to disqualification from the selection process, potentially with retrospective effect. Appointment of selected candidates is subject to being declared medically fit and executing a Contract Bond of ₹2,00,000 for a minimum 2-year service commitment. Candidates should keep their registered email ID and mobile number active throughout the recruitment process, since call letters and other communication will be sent through these channels.

content_sections.heading: APCOB Vacancy 2026: Post-Wise and District-Wise Details
content_sections.text: A total of 338 vacancies have been notified across the six DCCBs. The table below gives the post-wise number of vacancies for each district. Out of the total notified vacancies, a fixed number of posts in each district (except Vizianagaram) are earmarked exclusively for in-service employees of Primary Agriculture Co-operative Societies (PACS) affiliated to that DCCB, subject to those candidates meeting the eligibility criteria specified in the notification. Category-wise (OC/BC/SC/ST/EWS) and PwBD/Ex-Servicemen break-up of vacancies is given separately in each district's official notification PDF, since the reservation percentage varies slightly by district.

content_sections.heading: APCOB Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Each DCCB recruits only for its own district's requirements, so candidates must be local to the erstwhile district of the post they are applying for. For example, only candidates local to erstwhile Chittoor district can apply for Chittoor DCCB posts, and only candidates local to erstwhile Kadapa district can apply for Kadapa DCCB posts, and so on for Nellore, Prakasam, Visakhapatnam, and Vizianagaram. Local status is generally determined based on either of the following: Having studied in an educational institution in the local area for at least 4 consecutive academic years up to the SSC (or equivalent) examination; or Having resided in the local area for at least 4 years immediately preceding the SSC (or equivalent) examination, if not covered under the study criterion above. Candidates who do not meet the 4-year local criterion may still be considered local under a 7-year study/residence criterion within the state, as detailed in the respective official notification. Candidates holding a graduation degree in any discipline can also explore more Graduate Government Jobs and Bank Jobs 2026 available across India. The age of the candidate is reckoned as on 01.06.2026. Minimum age: 20 years Maximum age: 30 years (for open market candidates, both Staff Assistant and Assistant Manager) Maximum age for PACS in-service candidates: Relaxation up to 45 years for OC, with further category-wise relaxation subject to an overall ceiling of 50 years The relaxation in upper age limit is cumulative as per government guidelines, and reserved-category candidates must submit the relevant community certificate at the time of document verification to claim age relaxation.

rows.educational_qualification_as_on_24_07_20: Graduation in any discipline from a recognized university, with knowledge of English, proficiency in Telugu, and working knowledge of computers.

Age relaxed by the period of continuous service, subject to a maximum age of 35 years (General), 38 years (BC), and 40 years (SC/ST)

The broad stages are: Stage 1: Online Written Examination Stage 2: Document Verification Stage 3: Medical Fitness Examination Stage 4: Final Appointment (subject to executing the service bond) The online test for Staff Assistant and Assistant Manager (open market candidates) will be conducted in English, carries 200 marks, and has a composite duration of 2 hours (120 minutes). The same negative marking rule of 0.25 marks per wrong answer applies to this test as well. The Certified PACS Secretary (CPS) study material (4 modules) has been indicated as the reference material for this test.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies in APCOB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 338 vacancies have been notified, comprising 295 Staff Assistant posts and 43 Assistant Manager posts across six District Cooperative Central Banks.

faq.question: Q2. What are the APCOB Recruitment 2026 online application dates?
faq.answer: Online registration starts on 24 July 2026 and closes on 7 August 2026. The last date for fee payment is also 7 August 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for APCOB Staff Assistant and Assistant Manager posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 20 and 30 years of age as on 1 June 2026, with age relaxation applicable for reserved categories as per government rules.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification for APCOB Staff Assistant?
faq.answer: Graduation in any discipline from a recognized university, along with knowledge of English, proficiency in Telugu, and working knowledge of computers.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification for APCOB Assistant Manager?
faq.answer: First class graduation in any discipline, or high second class in Commerce (55% and above), or a postgraduate degree, along with knowledge of English, Telugu, and computers.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for APCOB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: ₹590 (inclusive of GST) for SC/ST/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen candidates, and ₹826 (inclusive of GST) for OC/BC/EWS candidates, payable online only.

faq.question: Q7. Is there an interview in APCOB Recruitment 2026 selection process?
faq.answer: No. Selection is based only on the online written examination, followed by document verification and a medical fitness check.

faq.question: Q8. When is the APCOB Recruitment 2026 exam date?
faq.answer: The online test is tentatively scheduled for August/September 2026. The exact date has not been announced in the notification and will be communicated through the call letter.

faq.question: Q9. Can candidates from any district apply for any DCCB post?
faq.answer: No. Each DCCB post requires local candidature (domicile) of that specific erstwhile district. For example, only local candidates of Kadapa district can apply for Kadapa DCCB posts.

faq.question: Q10. Is there a service bond for selected candidates?
faq.answer: Yes. Selected candidates for both Staff Assistant and Assistant Manager posts must execute a Contract Bond of ₹2,00,000, committing to serve the Bank for a minimum of 2 years.
